**ActionButton12 1.2.3 — Action Button HUD with Sliders**

* Long-press Power (0.6s) or Home button to trigger Action HUD
* Interactive real-time volume and screen brightness sliders
* Quick toggles: Flashlight, Camera, Voice Memos, Screenshot
* 100% lazy UIWindow instantiation bound to Main Queue
* Strict Pure GNU Tar format (resolves corrupted filesystem tarfile error)

**Compatibility:** iPhone 5s (Apple A7 arm64), iOS 12.0 – 12.5.8.
**Architecture:** Rootful Sileo / Zebra / Cydia APT.
